text: sssss
notes: Stretchy sound. A clean hiss held for about 1 second. Never the letter name "ess". No vowel before or after.

text: a, as in ant
notes: Short vowel /æ/ as in ant, apple, cat. Generate the phrase, then trim to the vowel only (about 0.4 s). Never the letter name "ay" and no "uh" after it.

text: tap
notes: Stop sound. Generate the word "tap" and trim to the first ~100 ms so only the crisp, unvoiced t burst is left. No "tuh", never "tee". If it can't be made clean, record it by hand.

text: pan
notes: Stop sound. Generate the word "pan" and trim to the first ~100 ms: a soft puff of air, unvoiced. No "puh", never "pee". Record by hand if trimming fails.

text: i, as in ink
notes: Short vowel /ɪ/ as in ink, insect, pin. Generate the phrase, trim to the vowel only (about 0.4 s). Never the letter name "eye".

text: nnnnn
notes: Stretchy sound. A hummed n held for about 1 second, mouth closed-ish. Never the letter name "en" and no "nuh".

text: Hello! This is Bip, a little robot who loves sounds. Click on an island to start exploring!
notes: Plays when the island map first opens. Narrator: warm, female South African English voice, speaking slowly and clearly for a 4-year-old.

text: That island is still asleep. Let's play on Letters Island!
notes: When a child clicks an island that isn't built yet. Gentle, not disappointed.

text: Welcome to Letters Island! Click Bip, and let's play.
notes: Plays when arriving on Letters Island.

text: Here's a new sound. Listen!
notes: Start of "Meet the sound". Followed by the sound clip three times.

text: Now you say it!
notes: After the picture word. Leave a short pause at the end for the child to copy.

text: Click the letter to hear it again. Click the green arrow when you're ready.
notes: End of "Meet the sound".

text: Find the picture that starts with…
notes: "Sound hunt" prompt. Followed straight away by a sound clip (e.g. snd_s), so end on a slight upward, expectant pause.

text: Pop the bubble that says…
notes: "Pop the letter" prompt. Followed straight away by a sound clip, so end on an expectant pause.

text: Wow! You really know that sound now!
notes: After three right answers in a row move a sound up a level. Excited.

text: Let's practise that sound again together.
notes: After two misses in a row drop a sound back. Kind and encouraging, never disappointed.

text: Great playing! Let's go back to the island.
notes: End of a round with no level change.

text: Well done!
notes: Random praise after a right answer. Vary the delivery across the set.

text: Brilliant!
You got it!
Super listening!
Excellent!
Fantastic!
Yes! That's the one!
Bip is so proud of you!
Amazing work!
Great job!
Listen carefully. It sounds like this:
notes: Spoken hint after two misses on one question. Followed by the sound clip; the right answer also wiggles on screen.

text: Here's a clue. Look for the one that's wiggling!
notes: Followed by the sound clip.

text: Let's listen again, together:
notes: Followed by the sound clip.

text: Nearly! Have another listen:
notes: Followed by the sound clip.

text: Follow the letter with your mouse. Sparkles will follow you!
notes: Start of Letter Trace.

text: Feed the monster only the foods that start with…
notes: Monster prompt. Followed straight away by a sound clip, so end on an expectant pause.

text: Tap each one as we count, then tap the number.
notes: Count & Tap prompt.

text: Look quickly… how many do you see?
notes: Quick Look prompt, said just as the dots appear.

text: Push each button, then find the word they make.
notes: Sound Buttons prompt.

text: Drag the letters to build the word in the picture.
notes: Word Builder prompt.

text: Put the pictures in order. What comes first?
notes: Morning Order prompt.

text: Snap the arrows together, then press Go to walk Bip home.
notes: Bip's Path prompt.

text: Welcome to Numbers Island! Click Bip, and let's count.
notes: Plays when arriving on Numbers Island.

text: Welcome to Words Island! Click Bip, and let's read.
notes: Plays when arriving on Words Island.

text: Welcome to Coding Island! Click Bip, and let's program.
notes: Plays when arriving on Coding Island.

text: Who's playing today? Click your picture!
notes: Plays on the profile picker when more than one child uses the Mac. Warm and inviting, a little pause before 'Click your picture'.
